name: Adzuki Bean Curry
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) adzuki beans, soaked overnight
1 tsp coriander powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp garam masala
steps: Pressure-cook the beans with 1½ cups water for 4 whistles until soft.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion, ginger, garlic and chilli for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the beans with their liquid and simmer for 10 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and coriander.
note: Adzuki beans are small and slightly sweet, and cook faster than rajma.
